title: PlusOS 2.0 Hardware Test #1: Mac SE & BlueSCSI WiFi
author: the1Domo
target_hardware: Macintosh SE / Macintosh Plus with BlueSCSI V2
instructions: Please test booting on real hardware with BlueSCSI. Verify the boot banner displays 'PlusOS 2.0 by the1Domo', test `theme 5` (Hacker Matrix), verify `net` connects to WiFi over SCSI ID 4, test `ping google.com` and `cube3d`. Report any screen artifacts or crashes.
